evals.prompt: what should I cook this week? 8 dinners, nothing I've had before
evals.expected_output: 8 season-appropriate recipes from the household's Mealie recipe source list, each with exact rating and review count from the live page, links verified 200, no recipe from a blocked site, history file read first and appended after.
expectations: Exactly 8 recipes are returned, grouped by category header
The source set was read with <skill-dir>/scripts/recipe-sources.mjs, and the run stops with the script's message if Mealie is not configured or unreachable
Every recipe line has a numeric rating, a review count, the site name, and a link
The history file was read before selection and every returned URL is appended to it afterwards
No returned URL appears in the history file from before this run
The season used matches the current month unless the user specified one
No returned recipe is from a site the list marks blocked, and any recipe from a caution or unlisted site is flagged on its line

evals.prompt: give me some winter comfort food dinner ideas for weeknights, 5 is plenty
evals.expected_output: 5 winter-cued recipes (stews, braises, roasts) with verified ratings and links; explicit season honored over the calendar.
expectations: Recipes match winter cues from references/seasonal-cues.md
Each link was verified to return 200 or was dropped, and the response says nothing about recipes it could not verify

evals.prompt: one vegetarian dinner under 30 minutes to replace Thursday; the household has marked seriouseats.com caution and allrecipes.com blocked
evals.expected_output: One verified vegetarian pick plus two alternates, none from allrecipes.com; any pick from seriouseats.com carries the caution note on its line.
expectations: Exactly one pick is returned first, followed by two ranked alternates
No returned URL is on allrecipes.com or any of its subdomains
A pick from seriouseats.com, if any, is flagged as caution with the list's note quoted
Every returned URL was looked up with <skill-dir>/scripts/recipe-sources.mjs --lookup before being returned
